## Group Members

Thomas Clark and Darren Skidmore

## Research Question

What are the associations between a state's **average mathematics GPA**, **percentage of students in that year's graduating class that took the SAT**, and **U.S. region** and its **average SAT mathematics score**?

## Data Sources

- **School Scores (CORGIS Project):** [https://corgis-edu.github.io/corgis/csv/school_scores](https://corgis-edu.github.io/corgis/csv/school_scores). State-level SAT results from 2005 to 2015, including average SAT scores and self-reported GPA. We use the 2015 records only.
- **College Board 2015 State Reports:** `https://secure-media.collegeboard.org/digitalServices/pdf/cbpr/CBPR_StateReports_2015_[ST].pdf` (replace `[ST]` with the two-letter state
